input: Pitch a new product feature to my team

gold.taskTitle: Pitch a New Product Feature to My Team
gold.taskDescription: Prepare and deliver a compelling pitch for a new product feature to the user's team.

questions.title: What specific product feature are you pitching?
questions.description: Understand the exact feature or idea the user wants to present.

questions.title: Who exactly is in the audience for this pitch?
questions.description: Identify whether the audience is engineers, designers, executives, stakeholders, or a mixed team.

questions.title: When does this pitch need to be delivered?
questions.description: Establish the deadline or scheduled date for the presentation.

questions.title: What format will the pitch take?
questions.description: Determine whether it will be a slide deck, a live demo, a written proposal, a verbal walkthrough, or something else.

questions.title: What is the main goal you want to achieve?
questions.description: Clarify the desired outcome, such as getting approval, gathering feedback, securing resources, or building buy-in.

questions.title: What data or evidence do you already have for this feature?
questions.description: Find out if the user has user research, metrics, competitor analysis, or other supporting material ready.

questions.title: What is the biggest objection you expect from the team?
questions.description: Surface the anticipated pushback so the pitch can proactively address it.
